zh.title: 臺灣國際航空燃油附加費 10 月 7 日調升　長程線升至 97.5 美元
zh.summary: 民航局公告，因航空燃油均價升至每桶 177.89 美元，國際線燃油附加費將由第 13 級調至第 15 級。
body: 交通部民用航空局於 2026 年 10 月 1 日公告，臺灣出發的國際線燃油附加費自 10 月 7 日起調升。短程航線每航段由 32.5 美元增至 37.5 美元，長程航線由 84.5 美元增至 97.5 美元。
民航局表示，2026 年 9 月航空燃油平均價格為每桶 177.89 美元，高於前一月的 156.79 美元，因此收費級距由第 13 級調高至第 15 級。
燃油附加費是機票價格的一部分，實際票價仍依航空公司、航線與開票條件而異。本次公告調整的是 10 月 7 日起開票適用的附加費級距，不代表所有航線總票價會以相同比例變動。

en.title: Taiwan raises international airline fuel surcharges from October 7
en.summary: The Civil Aviation Administration says the long-haul surcharge will rise to US$97.50 after jet-fuel prices moved into tier 15.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration announced on October 1, 2026 that fuel surcharges for international tickets issued from October 7 would increase. The per-segment charge will rise from US$32.50 to US$37.50 on short-haul routes and from US$84.50 to US$97.50 on long-haul routes.
The regulator said the average aviation-fuel price for September was US$177.89 per barrel, up from US$156.79 in the previous month. That moved the surcharge calculation from tier 13 to tier 15.

Fuel surcharges form only one component of an airfare. The final ticket price will still depend on the airline, route and fare conditions, so the change does not imply an identical percentage increase for every itinerary.

facts.claim: The new surcharge applies to international tickets issued from 2026-10-07.
Short-haul and long-haul per-segment surcharges rise to US$37.50 and US$97.50 respectively.
September average aviation-fuel price was US$177.89 per barrel and the tier changed from 13 to 15.
